I wrote the spoken reply to `reply.txt` in this folder. It says:

> The easiest way is the Work With Me button at the top of the page, in the header. You can also scroll to the contact section on the home page. Either one will get your message to Shauna.

I read all four files first. `FACTS.md` was the only one with content, and it gave the contact route. `prompt.txt` is the task itself. `session.json` and `session.err` were empty.

I left out the web address because it's awkward to hear read aloud. I also didn't claim the form reaches Shauna by email, because `FACTS.md` only names the button and the contact section. "Get your message to Shauna" is my own wording for what the button does. Check that it's accurate.

I didn't find any spoken-reply rules in this folder. They live in `DESIGN.md` in the main repo, so I kept the reply short and plain without having read them.
